text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spot Zenno Rob Roy and

Matikanetannhauser in the cafeteria
kitchen.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
In the story, they made it with a
sparkling,
prismatic carrot they found at
the end of a
rainbow.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wow! A rainbow, huh? I hope we'll be
able to find
one in time.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Finding a rainbow is one thing, but I
don't think
carrots that sparkle in
multiple colors actually
exist...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It may be prudent to brainstorm some
substitutes.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Like a bunch of carrots that are different
colors?
We could find some yellow and
purple carrots,
but... Hmm... That sounds
really hard too.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
O-oh, um... We're trying to recreate the

rainbow-colored carrot cake from one of
the
books I read recently.
choice_data_list: 一体、何を作ってるんだ？
choice_data_list_en: What on earth are you making?
What on earth are you making?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The story is about three chefs who go on
journeys
in a food truck and cook in all
kinds of different
places.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
At the end of their adventure, they
create a cake
with all the ingredients
they've obtained, and it
just sounded so
gorgeous and delicious!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure recreating a fantasy cuisine will
be quite
difficult, but I'd still like to give
it a try and feel
what it's like to be in
that world!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Adventure, exploration, and discovery!
El is back
and at your service!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy! Look, look! I got all the
ingredients we
need to make the
twilight-infused void cream!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I got us 99% cocoa powder, charcoal
powder,
and squid ink paste to top it all
off!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, El! Let's try making
the void
cream right away!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They start improvising their way through
the
whole cake recipe, until...

text_block_list.name: All Three
text_block_list.text: Finished!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Perfecto! We totally nailed the
pure-black
decorations!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I think so too! Now to cut the cake!
If we did
it right, the cross section
should be separated
into pretty
rainbow-colored layers!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Qué?! What happened?! Why is the
inside a
marbly mess?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ewww! And what's that green stuff
oozing out
from between each layer?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh no... That's right! I remember reading
in a
cookbook that the anthocyanin in
purple food
coloring has a tendency to
change colors!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I should've looked up how to make sure
the colors
don't mix together...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, you two... I wasn't prepared
enough.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's okay! It's normal to mess up the first
time you
try something. Let's just try
again!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Así es! My papa taught me that the
strong learn
from their failures!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Oh, thanks, guys!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I truly do... I would've been crushed by
my failure
if I were alone.
choice_data_list_en: They're really reassuring allies, aren't they.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: But we were successful, in a way, weren't we? We recreated the three chefs sharing a special experience together.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! This cake might not be a looker,
but it
sure is delicious!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué?! Hey, no fair! I want some too!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: W-wait, I want to try it as well!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The three of them happily share the
cake. It
seems the time they spent
working on it together
made it even
more tasty.
